comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation did not provide voluntary financial support to consolidated or unconsolidated VIEs during 2024, 2023, and 2022 that it was not previously contractually required to provide, nor does it intend to do so.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Bank of America (BAC) disclose policies regarding voluntary financial support to affiliated entities. GS states it may provide voluntary financial support and waive/defer fees, though impacts were immaterial in 2024. BAC explicitly states it did not provide voluntary financial support to VIEs during 2024, 2023, and 2022 that it was not contractually required to provide, nor does it intend to do so. The key difference is BAC's categorical denial of voluntary support and lack of intention to provide it, whereas GS retains the option to provide such support (via fee waivers/deferrals) in the ordinary course.
